credit.credit-words: THE PUBLIC DOMAIN SONG ANTHOLOGY | https://doi.org/10.32881/book2

direction-type.words: Many people do not know that “My Old Kentucky Home” is an anti-slavary ballad. Inspired by Stowe’s famous novel Uncle Tom’s Cabin, the ballad deals with similar themes of loss and family separation. Frederick Douglass acknowledged the abolitionist roots of the song in his autobiography, saying it “awakens [in white americans] sympathies for the slave, in which antislavery principles takeroot, grow, and flourish.”
